integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Let shortcuts, scripts and other apps send data to MoneyMatter without signing in as you.

ingestTokens.title: Ingest tokens
ingestTokens.description: A token lets one shortcut or script add card payments to your account. Each token works for a single purpose and can be revoked at any time.
ingestTokens.loadError: Could not load your tokens. Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No tokens yet
empty.description: Create a token to connect an iOS Shortcut or a script that logs card payments.

revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.description: {name} stops working at once. Any shortcut or script that uses it gets an authorization error until you give it a new token.

create.title: Create ingest token
create.description: Name the token after what will use it, so you can tell tokens apart later.
create.namePlaceholder: Enter a name, for example iPhone shortcut
create.nameRequired: Enter a name for the token.

secret.title: Your new token
secret.description: Copy the token now and keep it somewhere safe.
secret.warning: You won't see this token again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
secret.label: Token
